research_notes: A future strict-probe helper document could predefine a richer backlog template per workload profile to reduce setup overhead.
That template should contain genuinely useful analysis/checkpoint tasks rather than repetitive filler.
It should scale expected unit count with target class and preserve bounded extensions.
This is permitted supporting development because it improves reproducibility of runtime measurement.
It should not become a new orchestration subsystem.
The current run already demonstrates the need and basic pattern.
